name: Chase the Money
description: Finds unpaid balances and promised follow-ups buried in the owner’s OWN message threads and drafts a reminder in the customer’s language. The owner reads and sends — the crew never messages anyone on its own.

intake.description: The owner’s OWN threads + the POS sales ledger for the window. Personal chats are skipped; injection frames are stripped at the gateway before any content reaches a model.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Normalize the incoming intake into clean units, drop anything out of scope (and, for account-reading crews, personal/non-business content), and never invent facts.

roles.title: Balance Finder
roles.goal: Scan the intake for unpaid or partly-paid orders and promised follow-ups; for each capture the customer, amount owed in MMK, the order/invoice reference, and the exact source quote it came from.

roles.title: Reminder Drafter
roles.goal: For each open balance draft a short, warm reminder in the CUSTOMER’s own language (Burmese or English), matched to how overdue it is and how good a customer they are. Draft only — never send.

output_contract.description: Open balances with amount owed in MMK and the source quote for each, plus ready-to-send reminder drafts. Nothing is sent — the owner approves and sends.
